segments.text: In the next three minutes, I will show you the exact strategy that doubled our average watch duration.
Most creators spend 80% of their time color grading and selecting music, completely ignoring structural pacing.
Um, so basically... let me find my notes here... uh, give me one second while I switch screens.
Here is the key insight: retention decay accelerates whenever you introduce dead air or delay the payoff.
Apply this three-step framework in your next cut, and watch your 30-second retention curve flatten.
